subject: af-dy
title: (R)AF.DY.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 253 (CMBA-9). AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), EXT-FT (extended functionalism), PROG-EXT-F (progressional extended functionalism) and IST-F (isolated focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From IST-F: POST (postulation), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From POST: PROJ-DYM (projectional dynamics).
